reviews.title: Cheap,Fast and RGB
reviews.comment: This RAM is great of those who are on a bit of a tighter budget and want to have good speeds and RGB.  So far of the three is months Iv owned it no issues at all. The boot times are solid and the build it too. For the price it doesn’t feel cheap and it fits great in my motherboard. (ASUS TUF AM4 GAMING B550-PLUS WIFI II Motherboard)
reviews.author: Elian

reviews.title: Works with Aura Sync.
reviews.comment: Honestly, I just bout a desktop and I thought it was lame to call it a gaming desktop and go cheap on the memory. I called the company just to make sure I knew what card to get (I never play under the hood) . I ordered these because they claim to work with my existing Aura Sync. I also have Razor for my keyboard and mouse, so I did not want several applications to get a profile I am looking for. I know it has nothing to do with performance, but hey, it is cool. Memory cards were easy to go in, checked online support for T-Force and Aura Sync, had it working after a quick update. Memory was recognized, I still ran a Windows Memory diagnostic to ensure we were free light. The look, the feel of these cards is impressive and match (built for) my desktop ROG perfectly. I am usually shy on third party hardware, but I am coming around. Thank you.
reviews.author: Todd Mullins

reviews.title: Wow Amazing
reviews.comment: I was super impressed with this ram kit. Ran perfect in my motherboard B760M. Recognized the 3200 speed right away didn’t even have to mess with the bios settings. The rgb lighting is one of the best I seen, I usually go with Corsair but this is just as good for cheaper. It’s a win win in my book. I use signal rgb to control the lighting and everything syncs perfectly. Couldn’t be happier with the purchase.
